Package Models

package Models
This package contains all model classes.
  • Class
    Description
    Advance
    Represents an Advance order in the game.
    AdvanceTest
    This class is used to test the functionality of the Advance class.
    Airlift
    Airlift class represents a card for executing Airlift operation in the game.
    AirliftTest
    This class is used to test the functionality of the Airlift class.
    Blockade
    The Blockade class represents a Blockade card in the game, which can be used to execute a defensive blockade on a target country.
    BlockadeTest
    The BlockadeTest class contains unit tests for the Blockade class.
    Bomb
    The Bomb class represents a Bomb card in the game, which can be used to execute a bomb action on a target country.
    BombTest
    This class is used to test functionality of Bomb class functions.
    Card
    Represents a card in the game.
    Continent
    Represents a continent with its attributes and operations.
    Country
    Represents a country with its attributes and operations.
    Deploy
    Represents a deploy order in the game.
    DeployTest
    This class is used to test functionality of Deploy order.
    Diplomacy
    Represents a diplomacy card in the game.
    DiplomacyTest
     
    GameState
    Represents the state of a game including the map, players, and unexecuted orders.
    IssueOrderPhase
    Represents the phase where players issue orders.
    LogEntryBuffer
    The LogEntryBuffer class extends Observable and represents a buffer for log messages.
    Map
    Represents a map consisting of continents and countries.
    MapTest
    The MapTest class contains unit tests for the Map class.
    Order
    Command of the Command pattern : This model class manages the orders given by the players.
    OrderExecutionPhase
    Represents the phase where orders are executed in the game.
    OrderExecutionPhaseTest
    The OrderExecutionPhaseTest class provides unit tests for the methods of the OrderExecutionPhase class.
    Phase
    Phase class represents an abstract phase in the game flow.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game, encapsulating all relevant attributes such as name, color, owned countries and continents, a list of orders, number of unallocated armies, card ownership, negotiation states, and more.
    PlayerTest
    This class is used to test functionality of Player class functions.
    StartUpPhase
    Represents the startup phase of the game.
